description: We have a burning passion for data (and keeping actual fires under control)! 🔥 We're taking on the challenge of harmonizing MODIS and VIIRS satellite hotspot observations to make wildfire detection more consistent, accurate, and actionable. Our mission? Connect the dots between satellites, spot the hotspots, and help keep wildfires from getting out of hand. We promise our only intention is to fight fire with data!
summary: Interactive US wildfire map: current and predicted fire probability from a Pyro (probabilistic) model that combines NASA FIRMS satellite detections with weather, terrain and fuels.
